title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1994 (265), Essential Commodities Act (12); Manipur in Excise Act (1496) and TADA Act (27); Madhya Pradesh in Indian Railways Act (520); Karnataka in PCR Act (94); Assam in Indian Passport Act (23); Bihar in Dowry Prohibition Act (571) and Arms Act (94). The above picture is indicative that States/UTs, who had enforced the various SLL Acts and apprehended more females were in a better position in preventing such occurrences of crimes and restricting the involvement of women.
